rv.q: Despite its familiar archive material, the show's all-encompassing presentation makes even the most recognisable moments from Aardman's body of work feel fresh, immersive and alive.
Ensuring there is something for everyone to be found at this cracking experience.

cn.t: Critics praise this immersive 360-degree projection experience at Lightroom for bringing beloved Aardman animations to grand, cracking life on an impressive scale.
